audit.why: 51.67% over 1080 games; EVEN at 6/10 matches the data and the mirror's inverse ratings. Early and mid belong to Volibear, teamfights to Galio.
audit.corrected: Lane difficulty stays 6/10 — decided by tracking Justice Punch (11/10/9/8/7s) and never walking in with it up.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and wants.foe[1] call Shield of Durand Galio's R. Shield of Durand is his W (18/17/16/15/14s, 275 range); his R is Hero's Entrance (180/160/140s).
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon slot names in the kit file. Mislabelling the ult tells the player to play around the wrong 180-second cooldown.
audit.corrected: Hero's Entrance (R) is 180s at rank 1 and a roam/teamfight tool; Shield of Durand (W) is the 18s taunt that matters in lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated: Thundering Smash is a speed-up whose stun only lands on the attack that follows, so Justice Punch's 650-range knockup denies the stun outright.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks' — the stun is attached to the attack, not the approach. Galio's E knocks up the first champion encountered.
audit.corrected: Never start the walk-up with Justice Punch up; the knockup lands before your attack does and the stun is wasted.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[6] and late credit Galio's 'damage-reduction' as a reason he beats you late. Shield of Durand's physical reduction is half its magic value, so it does little against an AD brawler.
audit.why: Verified on the mirror side and reused: Shield of Durand cuts magic 25/30/35/40/45% and physical exactly half that.
audit.corrected: His late-game edge is taunt, MR stacking and Hero's Entrance presence — not damage reduction against your physical damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: early writes 'Relentless Storm' for Volibear's passive.
audit.why: The passive is The Relentless Storm; packet flagged it as a near-miss name.
Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s and Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14s — concrete windows beat 'when it's down'.
audit.corrected: Commit in the 11 seconds after Justice Punch is spent.
